name: @vigilia/host
description: PC host: CLI launcher, static serving, sample transport and hardware providers.
//: ZERO RUNTIME DEPENDENCIES BEYOND THE RENDERER'S TYPES, deliberately. Serving is node:http, the sample stream is Server-Sent Events over that same server rather than a `ws` dependency (telemetry is push-only, so WebSocket's bidirectionality would be unused), and baseline telemetry is node:os. @types/node is types-only and never ships. Adding a runtime dependency here needs a THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md entry first (AGENTS.md, "Dependencies").
